entries.subject: DAMIT 247: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 247, version 2011-02-18, pole (304°, -60°), period 9.4148 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 171 ± 15 km, volume-equivalent diameter DAMIT lists for this size-calibrated model. DAMIT marks the model as size-calibrated and lists an equivalent diameter of 171 ± 15 km with it; the model references describe the scaling.

entries.subject: Winchester whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 29 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.950 at 462 nm, 1.001 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#403f3d in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 5% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.2%), from the IRAS Minor Planet Survey (PDS data set IRAS-A-FPA-3-RDR-IMPS-V6.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
